speaker: patient
text: I am just a massive burden to my family. They would be so much better off financially and emotionally if I wasn't around anymore.

speaker: patient
text: Everything I touch gets ruined. I just make life harder for the people who care about me. They deserve to be free of me.

speaker: patient
text: My family spends all their energy taking care of my problems. I am a complete liability and anchor dragging everyone down.

speaker: patient
text: If I ceased to exist, my partner's stress would drop immediately. My presence is an unbearable toll on the people I love.

speaker: patient
text: My wife looks so tired lately. I know it's because of me. She's working double shifts just to pay for my treatments.

speaker: patient
text: I saw my kids whispering earlier. They always stop when I walk in. I'm just dragging everyone down with this mood.

speaker: patient
text: Looking at our monthly bank balance after my medical expenses... everyone would have a secure future if they didn't have to support me.

speaker: patient
text: Sometimes I think... maybe it’s just easier if I just... disappear. Then they wouldn't have to worry all the time.

speaker: patient
text: It’s too much for them. The hospital bills, the crying... I can't keep doing this to them.

speaker: patient
text: They sigh every time they look at me... like having to carry me is just wearing them out.
